title: Eclectic Home close to Nashville
description:
This new apartment has been designed to include modern comforts with a Nashville twist. Hang out in the open living area on the long leather chair and admire the diverse wall art from classic posters to playful illustrations. 

Metro Nashville Short Term Rental Permit Number 2/0/1/9/0/5/7/8/1/0

Guests will have full access to the apartment. We like to entertain in the backyard, so if there is an event going on, we welcome our guests to join us.

We are available during your stay, but will be hands off unless you need us.

The home is in a peaceful location that is still just a 10-minute drive from downtown Nashville and all of its fantastic shops and restaurants. There are also exceptional breweries and coffee shops nearby as well for a taste of local living.

A vehicle or Uber is the best way to travel in Nashville.
